messages:
maya (Support): Hey @kevin @ada — customer Acme's indexer started failing after yesterday's model swap. Ingestion errors show "vector dimension mismatch: expected 1024 got 1536". They kicked off a backfill which may have mixed embeddings from two model versions. Logs below.

indexer-bot: indexer pipeline run 2026-03-16T22:14:01Z — failed: VEC_DIM_MISMATCH id=acct-acme/doc-123 expected=1024 actual=1536 shard=3

luis (Acme): Confirmed. We swapped to new model (embed-xl) at 21:50 UTC. Backfill started at 21:55. Some docs went through the older embed-api (1024). Rejections are spiking and throughput dropped.

kevin (ML Eng): Likely cause: rolling swap didn't pin model id for in-flight batches; the batcher aggregated embeddings produced by two runtime configs. Check endpoint versioning and batch boundaries. Can you share a sample failed payload?

maya (Support): Pasting minimal repro from their backfill worker (sanitized):
```json
{"id":"doc-123","model":"embed-xl","vector":[...1536 floats...]}
```
And the reject log line:
`ERROR indexer: expected_dim=1024 got=1536 doc=doc-123 shard=3`

ada (Platform): @kevin Also check the API key routing — if some workers hit a legacy cached gateway that routes to embed-v1 (1024) while others hit embed-xl (1536) we can get mixed dims. @maya can you confirm if they used rotating tokens or multiple images?

maya (Support): Acme says they used the same API key for backfill but have multiple worker versions in the fleet (older container image on some nodes). They updated images across nodes concurrently.

kevin (ML Eng): OK — short action list: 1) stop the backfill; 2) scan the index for mixed-dim vectors (detect docs where vec length != 1536); 3) fail-fast on ingest when dim mismatch to avoid partial inserts. I can provide a detection/fix script.

james (Support Lead): +1 — escalate to SRE if index corruption possible. Can we snapshot the index before any automated fixes? @ada

ada (Platform): Snap requested. We'll snapshot shard range 0-5 now. Index snapshot job started: snap-20260316-001.

luis (Acme): Thanks — what's the clean recovery path? Reindex everything with single model version?

kevin (ML Eng): Two options:
- Preferred: pause backfill, tag all workers to use embed-xl, verify no mixed-dim vectors, then rerun backfill from checkpoint.
- Alternative: if rerun impossible, run a conversion job to re-embed 1024 vectors with embed-xl or implement a compatibility conversion (risky).

maya (Support): I told the customer to pause backfill and they confirmed pause. They've asked for a repro script and a safe backfill checklist.

kevin (ML Eng): I'll drop a small detection + fix script in the ticket. Example detection command:
```bash
# list docs with unexpected dim
curl -s 'https://indexer.internal/api/scan?shard=3' | jq '.[] | select(.vec | length != 1536) | .id'
```

indexer-bot: retention-guard: backfill paused by luis (Acme) at 2026-03-16T22:20:12Z

maya (Support): Follow-ups: kevin (provide scripts), ada (snapshot + verify), I'll coordinate with Acme for rerun. Marking P1 since customer's search is degraded.

james (Support Lead): Thanks team. We'll keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
